Why Kindness to Animals Matters More Than Ever
How we treat animals says a great deal about who we are. Whether it is a family pet, a farm animal, or wildlife in a local park, every animal can experience fear, stress, and pain. Choosing compassion is not just about protecting them. It also helps build a more thoughtful, responsible society.
